answer: Prayers & Duties >> Salah (Prayer) Question ID: 51397 Country: United Kingdom Title: Muadhin without a fist length beard Question: In my mosque, the muazzin does not have a fist length beard. Is he allowed to give the adhan? What if he has a fist length beard but he smokes in public? Answer ID: 51397 Posted on: Aug 31, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 669/552/B=05/1435) If he cuts his beard then his azan is makrooh tahrimi. However, merely by smoking cigarette his azan shall not be makrooh tahrimi. قال فى الدر المختار : يكره أذان جنب واقامته ..... وفاسق ولو عالماً . (الدر المختار 2/60) Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
